The '''Type 10 Cutting Saw''' was a model of [[Circular saw/Legends|circular saw]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. The saw's [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] blades were designed to cut through thick power cables, foliage, and [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]] among other things. Designed to be fitted on [[Droid/Legends|droid]], the saw had two configurations. It could be mounted externally on the droid, or be installed internally.<ref name="CFTD" />
